### 1. Scene
A cold meal of three rice-paper rolls, apparently containing chicken and lettuce, and four vegetable sushi pieces. Soy sauce, pickled ginger, and orange juice accompany it.

### 2. Vessel
The shallow round plate appears approximately **23 cm in diameter**.  
Area = 3.14 × 11.5² ≈ **415 cm²**.

### 3–7. Items, area, volume, weight, and energy
The rolls and sushi cover approximately **72% of the plate** altogether. Their fillings are included in the composite estimates, not counted separately. The drink and condiments are measured in their own containers.

| Item | Plate area | Gross volume calculation | Bulk density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Three chicken-and-lettuce rice-paper rolls | 48% | 199 cm² × 2.0 cm = 398 ml | 0.68 g/ml | 271 g | 125 | 339 kcal |
| Four vegetable sushi pieces | 24% | 100 cm² × 1.8 cm = 180 ml | 0.80 g/ml | 144 g | 145 | 209 kcal |
| Soy sauce | Separate cup | Approximately 15 ml | 1.0 g/ml | 15 g | 55 | 8 kcal |
| Pickled ginger | Separate cup | Approximately 30 ml | 0.60 g/ml | 18 g | 60 | 11 kcal |
| Orange juice | Glass | Approximately 250 ml | 1.04 g/ml | 260 g | 45 | 117 kcal |

No separate oil or dressing is visibly identifiable.

### 8. Sanity check
About **415 g on the plate** is plausible for three substantial fresh rolls and four sushi pieces. Including condiments and juice, the estimate is **708 g and 684 kcal**. The roll filling and glass volume are the largest uncertainties.
